name: menu-serving-mode
title: Expose portion and weight pricing in menu item modal
description: Expose the existing recipe serving mode contract in the manager menu item modal so each serving variant can be priced by portion or by kilogram.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Backend and Apollo contracts already support multiple PORTION/BY_WEIGHT serving variants. The implementation exposes and normalizes that existing contract in the manager menu item modal, reuses current responsive form styles, and adds focused source-contract coverage. No executable checkout was available for Vitest or build validation.
